title: 7 Iconic Stops in Banff National Park with Lake Minnewanka
includes: Local coffee, tea, hot chocolate & water refills
Convenient shuttle service with belongings accessible all day.
Binoculars available for wildlife viewing at scenic stops.
Insightful storytelling on Banff’s history, geology & wildlife.
Hiking poles available upon request for added stability.
Max 13 guests for a more personal, intimate experience.
Ponchos and umbrellas provided for rain protection.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Children under 6 years old and 18 kg (40 lbs) or less must use a child safety seat. Please provide us your child’s age, seat type (rear-facing, forward-facing, or booster), and how many you require (or bring your own).

In order to participate all adults must sign a waiver prior to the tour. A waiver must also be completed by the parent or guardian of any child under the age of 18. Failure to complete the waiver will result in the cancellation of your tour.
Our tours operate rain or shine. For your comfort, please wear appropriate clothing for the unpredictable mountain weather.
No-shows, missed departures, or unused services are non-refundable.
We require at least 4 guests for the tour to proceed. If we don’t reach this minimum number, we will offer you options to reschedule or receive a full refund.

The tour begins with pickups in Canmore, followed by pickups in Banff approximately 30 minutes later. You will receive your pickup details after booking, so please be sure to review this message carefully to help you prepare.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the breathtaking landscapes of Banff National Park on a scenic tour featuring seven iconic stops. From the powerful Bow Falls to the serene Vermilion Lakes, each location offers unique views and photo opportunities. Enjoy ample time at Lake Minnewanka, where you can stroll along the shore, spot wildlife, or participate in an optional wildlife education session. With a knowledgeable local guide, uncover the rich history and geology of the Rockies while traveling in a small group for a personalized experience. This tour is perfect for nature lovers and families looking to connect with the stunning outdoors of Banff.

- Tour includes seven iconic stops, showcasing Banff's natural beauty
- Small group experience with a maximum of 13 guests for personalized attention
- Optional wildlife education session with hands-on learning tools
- Comfortable shuttle service with complimentary warm beverages and photo opportunities at each stop
